name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to certain exclusion criteria (income tax payers, government employees above a certain grade, etc.)
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or through the local Common Service Centre (CSC)

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
eligibility: Families identified as economically vulnerable based on SECC 2011 database, primarily rural and urban poor
benefits: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or visit the nearest Ayushman Bharat Kendra with Aadhaar and ration card

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including loanee and non-loanee farmers
benefits: Crop insurance covering losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, insurance companies, or the National Crop Insurance Portal before the sowing season deadline

name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
eligibility: Rural households without a pucca house, identified via SECC 2011 and Awaas+ survey
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.2-1.3 lakh to construct a pucca house
how_to_apply: Apply through the Gram Panchayat or check status at pmayg.nic.in

name: Jan Dhan Yojana
eligibility: Any Indian citizen without an existing bank account, especially targeting unbanked rural households
benefits: Zero-balance bank account, RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance, overdraft facility up to ₹10,000
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent with Aadhaar and address proof
